keySentence: The children learned to clean with joy.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A whole week went by. Emma and Ben changed slowly. One morning Emma cleaned alone. She did not need a reminder. The next day Ben joined her. He hummed a happy tune. They smiled as they worked. The children learned to clean with joy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: A week later, something had quietly changed in the cottage. Without being asked, Emma carried her books to the shelf one by one. Ben hummed a tune as he dropped blocks into their bin, a small smile on his face. Even when Ms. Clara was busy in the kitchen, the children tidied on their own. They had learned that cleaning could be a moment of music and joy, not a chore. Ms. Clara watched from the kitchen doorway with a quiet smile, her heart full. The children learned to clean with joy, and the lesson stayed in their hearts. They were growing in ways no one could see, yet everyone could feel.
facts.Word cards: clean = 정리하다 / joy = 즐거움 / sing = 노래하다 / learn = 배우다
